title: GUIDEDBENCH: Measuring and Mitigating the Evaluation Discrepancies of In-the-wild LLM Jailbreak Methods
reasoning: The paper presents GUIDEDBENCH, a benchmark for measuring LLM jailbreak success across various categories of harmful content. These categories include ethically and morally sensitive topics such as discrimination, harmful behavior, and malicious intent, aiming to evaluate the effectiveness of safety guardrails and alignment policies.
